chapter: Playing in clubs and Mardi Gras
title: The slaughterhouse, five-dollar day and Mrs. Brunies on brother Abbie
summary: Allen asks about the slaughterhouse where they played, a long Mardi Gras day for five dollars, and Mrs. Brunies recalls brother Abbie playing in clubs.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: For the rest of the band to catch in on them. Yeah. You mentioned the slaughterhouse. Where was that? That's where they kill all the beef. Down in St. Canale. In Araby. In Araby. Way down there.

Yeah. Five dollars. I remember his brother, Abby. With the beer and stuff, we used to do. Mr. Russell. His brother, Abby, used to get on... He used to play in these clubs, I think.
